title: GistUI capability object
description: What a host tells a generator about the processor, runtime, renderer, catalog and tools it will use (GistUI Format 1.0, section 26.4).

gistui.description: The highest format version the processor implements.

mode.description: document: the whole answer is a program. inline: Markdown with gistui blocks.

edit.description: True when the generator is to write edits to a program the host supplies.

tools.description: Tools a program can name in @query and @mutation.

args.description: A short summary of the arguments, for example {range:str}.
